newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 26.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 26.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Less farmers than expected took part in agricultural demonstrations at border-crossings on Wednesday.
- The Free Democrat's, the junior member party in the ruling coalition, said that the law amendments approved by the Parliament on Tuesday decreased tension in the agricultural sector.
- Slovakia attacked before the Hague international court Hungary's legal explanations for why Hungary abandoned the contract for the construction of a water power plant on the Danube.

- The Jewish organisation MAZSIHISZ joined the Free Democrat's in an initiation to remove Agnes Maczo from the post of deputy chairman of the Parliament for an alleged anti-Semitic declaration of Maczo.
- Public employees protest because they say their monthly wage has been delivered recently with one week delays.
